description: Repo-hygiene artifacts -- what the block is (README.md), its spec index (spec/README.md), its license, the agent instructions (CLAUDE.md) and the CI workflow -- plus the repo's own offline audit commands for the two things T1 item 10 asks CI to keep valid: the evidence formats and the simulation harness. Every declared check is stdlib-only, needs no PDK and no simulator, and is deterministic on any runner image, so none is marked `local_only` and CI re-runs all three. None of them invokes `klt signoff`, so this attestation never grades itself. `sim/characterization/generate.py --check` is deliberately NOT declared here: it reproduces a float-bearing artifact and is therefore pinned to a specific runner image in its own CI job (characterization-report), and declaring it would make item 10's attestation inherit that image sensitivity. Presence, freshness and audit-gate state only: NOT a performance or spec-compliance claim.
